facts.fact: Burundi Times reports the Ministry of the Interior presented on 6 May 2026 one digital platform to underpin the new civil status system and production of biometric national ID cards.
facts.system: digital civil registration platform and biometric national identity card system

BDI.note: No count or share enrolled; old paper cards still in use and fresh registration required.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Operation and maintenance are not described.
No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: Ministry of the Interior's Valentin Nahimana said on 6 May 2026 Burundi is technically ready to produce biometric national ID cards but awaits adoption of the law governing their use.
